title: Mozilla ie deep footer effect loss

change.control: Pages with a simplified footer retaining Privacy Policy, Legal Notices and Report Trademark Abuse links.
change.variant: Include the deep footer instead of the simplified footer.

quote: The main features box, the deep footer, and the switching tips all drove conversions down.
notes: Reported factor-level effect from one 16-recipe multivariate test, not a separate independently randomized study. Other three elements varied across recipes. No per-factor numeric lift, sample or significance is published. Population: Internet Explorer landing-page visitors. Business type reflects the nonprofit-owned browser organization; the conversion is a browser download, not a SaaS subscription.
